signIn.title: Sign in

no_account.title: There's no Fusion account for {email}.
no_account.more: If you were invited, open the link in your invitation email.

email_not_verified.title: {provider} says this address isn't verified.
email_not_verified.more: Use an account whose address your company has verified.

linked_to_someone_else.title: This address is linked to a different {provider} account.

provider_off.title: Your company doesn't use {provider} to sign in.

invitation_mismatch.title: {provider} signed you in as {email}.
invitation_mismatch.more: This invitation is for {invited}. Choose that account, or create a password.

invitation_closed.title: This invitation can't be used any more.
invitation_closed.more: Ask whoever invited you to send a new one.

existing_account.title: This address already has a Fusion account.
existing_account.more: Sign in instead, or ask your administrator.

operator.title: Fusion's own staff sign in with a password.

access_paused.title: Your access to Fusion is paused.

expired.title: Signing in took too long. Try again.

provider_failed.title: {provider} couldn't sign you in. Try again.
